notes: ART_BIBLE 6: 'matte, fibrous, warm NEUTRAL against every biome palette.' v1 was none of those things — measured on shots/car-launch.png the lit flap came back HSV s0.89 v0.94, i.e. MORE saturated than the meadow it is supposed to sit neutrally against, carrying the meadow's own blob generator at the meadow's own on-screen size. Box and grass read as one material with a hue swap. Three changes, and only the third is a colour. (1) brushStrength 0.62 -> 0.20 and brushSaturation 0.45 -> 0.13: the paint layer becomes paper mottling instead of camouflage. (2) brushScale 0.5 -> 2.6 and regionStep 0.22 -> 0.06. v1's note claimed 0.5 m was 'deliberately the smallest in the project' and that was self-defeating — painterly.ts selects its octave by PROJECTED size (STROKE_PX), so an authored scale below the ladder's floor never reaches the screen and the box got the meadow's 13 px stroke regardless. At 2.6 the ladder CLAMPS at lod -4 over the whole box, which pins the finest octave at a world-locked 0.163 m instead: ~35 screen pixels at the car framing, a frequency the terrain never produces. (3) kraft. base drops from s0.61 to s0.42 and the lit stop from s0.47 to s0.28, so a sunlit panel lands near the s0.35 kraft actually measures at. The cardboard READ now lives in geometry — see src/vehicle/box.ts for the flutes, the corner creases, the tape and the print, none of which existed. detailStrength and reliefShade are cut because a noise relief fights a real fluted one. Shadow is authored WARM and cooled at runtime by shadowSkyTint. Brush overlay reduced 0.2 -> 0.18: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain.
